plan.objective: Stabilize at 6 life against the opponent's double-striking Kellan and preserve blockers while rebuilding a landfall threat; attack only when lethal is established or defense is no longer viable.
plan.guidance: Observed turn 13 draw step, with precombat main and combat still ahead. The former Vein line is impossible: Promising Vein and Chocobo are in the graveyard, and Explorer is only in hand. A Forest is in hand and one land play remains. First play Forest, then cast Explorer for {2}{G}{G} from the six currently untapped Forests, retaining two untapped Forests if payment permits; its landfall does not trigger from the already-played Forest. Do not assume a graveyard land is playable this turn unless Explorer resolves and a land play remains. Current opponent is at 18; Kellan is tapped (3/2 double strike) and Sanctuary is tapped (animated 3/3 vigilance), so no attack wins now. Your lands are not creatures; Ascensions have no attacker. Life is 6, so prioritize a blocker/threat and keep a real green source available for Veil against targeted removal. Reassess after Explorer resolves and its mill occurs. No current stack response is needed.

steps.label: Play Forest from hand
steps.purpose: Use this turn's land play to develop mana; Zhao is gone so no nonbasic restriction applies.

steps.label: Cast Icetill Explorer
steps.purpose: Establish future additional-land and graveyard access; retain available green for protection if possible.

procedure.basis: You may play an additional land on each of your turns.

phases.goal: Play the visible Forest and establish Explorer without pretending the lost Vein is available.
phases.guidance: Play Forest first, then cast Explorer for {2}{G}{G} if payable from the six untapped Forests after the land play. Its entry triggers both Ascensions' landfall abilities; resolve those choices, targeting a useful creature only if one exists (none is currently on your battlefield). Resolve Explorer's mill, then reassess graveyard contents. Do not sacrifice or search with Promising Vein; it is in the graveyard and no current action retrieves it. Preserve an untapped Forest for Snakeskin Veil if possible. You are at 6 life; prioritize survival over optional deployment.

phases.goal: Do not attack into the current board without a lethal or survival-based reason.
phases.guidance: You currently have no battlefield creatures, so no attacker is available. The opposing Kellan and animated Sanctuary are tapped; do not invent an attack with an Ascension or land. Reassess only if an actual creature enters and is eligible to attack.

phases.goal: Preserve life and block if a blocker becomes available.
phases.guidance: You currently have no creatures to block with. If Explorer resolves this turn, it will be summoning sick but can block on the opponent's turn. Block a meaningful ground attacker with Explorer when doing so prevents damage and does not sacrifice a more valuable winning line; Veil can protect it from targeted removal, not combat damage. No creature can block a flyer absent flying or reach.

phases.goal: Protect the recovery nucleus against targeted removal and reassess the clock.
phases.guidance: Hold one untapped Forest for Snakeskin Veil only if Veil is in hand and the source remains genuinely untapped. Opponent's visible Kellan is already 3/2 with double strike and its combat-damage trigger; track whether it untaps or gains haste/new attackers. Hexproof does not stop burn to you. At 6 life, prioritize a credible blocker or lethal attack over speculative development.

phases.goal: Recount survival and next-turn landfall opportunities.
phases.guidance: Recount life, visible board, mana, hand and graveyard after all combat and spells. Do not assume a future draw or a specific Explorer mill.
